# BuildFlow Business Entity Resolution

Problem: A business has duplicate or conflicting customer/vendor identities across systems and needs evidence-preserving matching with human adjudication rather than silent merges.
Pricing: No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: human_auth_handoff
Public capability: https://base44.app/api/apps/6ab26dc00debf9a25bca5f3e/functions/enterpriseOpsAgentRoute
Human review: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=buildflow-entity-resolution-machine-v1
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Use when the user says or means:
- dedupe our vendor list safely
- the same customer exists in multiple systems
- match vendors without silently merging them
- resolve duplicate suppliers across ERP exports
- AI found uncertain business entity matches
- reconcile customer or vendor identity conflicts

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
